name: hudl-volleyball-mcp
description: Production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Hudl and Balltime volleyball match breakdowns, player box scores, rotation analytics (P1-P6), and DataVolley (.dvw) touches.

hudl_cookie.title: Hudl Session Cookie (Optional)
hudl_cookie.description: Optional: Paste your Hudl 'ident' session cookie if you do not want to use interactive browser login.

hudl_team_id.title: Default Team ID (Optional)
hudl_team_id.description: Optional default Hudl Team ID. If omitted, the server automatically auto-discovers your team.

hudl_email.title: Hudl Account Email (Optional)
hudl_email.description: Optional: Hudl account email if using headless automated cookie refresh.

hudl_password.title: Hudl Account Password (Optional)
hudl_password.description: Optional: Hudl account password for headless automated cookie refresh.
